entry.title: 💼 Out-of-Office You, Not Excuses

20 Slack notifications 💬
7 urgent follow-ups ⚠️
Scheduled calls you forgot existed 🔔

and only escalates what truly matters. Your weekend… stays your weekend. ✨
Task Before After AI

Support Queries Context switching every 10 mins AI categorizes + suggests replies
Deployment Alerts Wake up at 3AM AI filters false alarms & logs summaries

Your value is solving actual problems. Let AI do the shallow work.
You focus on deep work — and real rest. This year: Build systems that defend your time
Delegate what drains your energy
Let AI work — while you recharge 🔋✨
Because productivity ≠ being always available.
